responsibilities: Design, build and maintain automated data pipelines from SPT’s operational and corporate systems into the data platform, replacing manual extract processes.
Model data into documented, tested, reusable structures that support consistent reporting across the organisation.
Build and maintain the semantic models that Power BI reporting consumes, ensuring definitions are consistent and performance is fit for purpose.
Implement automated data quality testing, monitoring and alerting, so that failures are detected before users encounter them.
Establish and maintain version control, deployment processes and environments appropriate to a small team.
Document data lineage, definitions and known limitations to support the organisation’s data governance framework.
Work with source system owners and suppliers to specify and agree the data SPT receives, including from third parties.
Support the Head of Business Intelligence in developing analytical capability across services, including advising colleagues building their own reporting.
Contribute to the technical elements of platform selection, sizing and cost management.
Provide occasional reporting using Power BI to support the rest of the Business Intelligence team.
Support the development of compelling business cases to support new projects and programmes.
Adopt, promote and enhance best practice project management practices throughout the team, through personal example, coaching, mentoring and guidance.
Adopt a proactive approach to continual professional development, preparing and successfully implementing a personal development plan, whilst also supporting the development of others.
Support the development and implementation of a culture of continuous improvement through the development of good practice in relation to information management and data analysis.

Comply with all of SPT’s Information Governance and Cyber Security policies and procedures and ensure that all of your work is carried out in a manner which supports these and meeting GDPR legislation.
Undertake other duties as may be required by the developing workload within the Business Intelligence team and support other related workload, as required.
